run_ax_sweep: run a Hydra Ax sweeper to optimize hyperparameters using the Ax platform
create_trial_batch: create a batch of parallel trials from an AxClient with configurable parallelism
parse_commandline_args: parse Hydra command line sweep overrides into Ax parameter dictionaries
map_params_to_arg_list: convert a dictionary of parameters into a list of key=value string arguments
encode_parameters_to_string: encode a list of Ax parameter dicts into a human-readable log string
